implement.approach: Test-first: commit 7f5ae4dd adds apps/mobile/__tests__/w05OfflineJourney.test.tsx (r3's 41 tests reused verbatim plus 17 round-4 tests pinning every prior-round finding: floor/none->anchored re-read, rollback while READY, lease-end progression, watch-is-not-SQL, no cadence when idle, no timers after unmount, transient read failure recovery + bounded backoff, Pro lease copy, 429 HOLD copy, stranded expired-generation tickets). Commit d18f1df4 adds apps/mobile/src/components/OfflineAllocationCard.tsx and wires it into AnalyzeScreen (useOfflineJourneyOnFocus(navigation), dark card under the ready-screen notes) and SettingsScreen (useOfflineJourney(), card under the Account group for synced accounts). Design: (1) scheduleFollowUp now covers every published state — 'unavailable' -> retry after UNAVAILABLE_RETRY_MS doubling per consecutive failure to 60 s (failedReads resets on a landed read); hold/pending -> PENDING_RECEIPT_READ_CADENCE_MS ledger re-read; any held grant with nothing pending -> TRUSTED_TIME_WATCH_MS trusted-time watch that calls trustedTime.read() (in-memory, no SQL) and re-reads the ledger only when evaluateLease() for any grant under the new reading has a different presentation fingerprint (kind / reconcile reason / rounded remaining) than the published verdict; an unreadable trusted reading counts as a change. Timers stay fenced by latestRead, mountedFollowers and isDataOwnerContextCurrent. (2) presentOfflineJourney derives `ready` from executableTickets() = sum of remaining tickets of free grants whose execution verdict is live (finite positive remainingMs), capped by spendableTickets; held-but-not-ready tickets are stated as belonging to 'an earlier pass that has ended' that 'stays allocated', badge CONFIRM ONLINE (never READY, never SPENT while held>0). (3) The allocation note is emitted only for free grants with held>0 — a Pro lease (time lease, no allocation) never claims results. (4) HOLD copy: unanswered presentation -> 'A result was sent to the server and no confirmation has been recorded on this phone yet' (no connection claim, covers dropped connections and HTTP refusals alike), server-held -> 'still confirming it', journal-only hold -> needs an online check; all state 'nothing is charged twice'. No data/, billing/, navigation/ or shared-types edits; the screens' hunks are the two imports, one hook call, one conditional render and one style entry each.
